['Alcatel-Lucent Deutschland AG '].company_description: Alcatel-Lucent Deutschland AG, now part of Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise, offers a portfolio of market-leading phones, headsets, wired and wireless networking products and services, as well as carrier-grade voice and video services with 99.999% uptime. They are dedicated to making switches and access points that allow for the reliable and error-free transfer of data, and also offer Ucopia and OmniVista tools for network management and monitoring.
